profile.headline: Founder @ Modment • Floxies Ambassador 🌸 • Designer • Developer • Strategist
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I’ve always been fascinated by why people do what they do: what catches their attention, what builds trust, what makes them act. That curiosity about human behavior and psychology runs through everything I’ve built.

Over the past 15+ years I’ve worked across publishing, engineering, product, design, and marketing at places like Condé Nast, PureWow, REI, and ExpandTheRoom. I’ve seen from the inside why some websites drive a business forward and others quietly sit there looking nice. Usually the difference isn’t the visuals. It’s whether the site was built around how real people think and decide.

Today I run Modment, the boutique digital agency I founded to help scaling businesses stand out in crowded categories. I work with clients nationwide from the NJ/NYC metro area, and I every project is senior-led, from strategy and branding through design and development. My focus goes beyond the website itself. I build the experiences and tools that get people to engage with a business, trust it, and ultimately choose it over the competition. Behind the scenes, I connect the systems that keep it all running, from marketing platforms to AI assisted workflows, on whichever platform fits the business best.

What people don’t expect is how much of the work is about people, not pixels. Before we design anything, we look at who your customers are, what they need to believe before they reach out, and where they hesitate. Every project is senior-led, so that thinking carries straight through to the code that ships.

If your digital presence isn’t pulling its weight, or isn’t keeping up as your business scales, send me a message.

positions.title: Founder & CEO
positions.description:
Modment is a boutique digital agency and senior-led growth partner for scaling service businesses that have outgrown looking like everyone else in their category. Based in the NJ/NYC metro area and working with clients nationwide, we bring strategy, branding, design, and development under one roof.

We focus on web strategy, turning your website into a growth engine, not a brochure. That means roadmaps, high-converting sites and funnels, ongoing testing, and connected marketing tools and AI workflows, on whichever platform fits best for your business: Webflow, Shopify, Wix Studio, Framer or custom stack.
positions.insights: Skills: Branding & Identity · Web Design · Webflow · Product Design · Web Development

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Transformed an outdated manual product entry process into an efficient internal business tool using Vue / Vuex, achieving a 500% reduction in time for entering new products. 

Collaborated closely with product designers, utilizing Figma to create high-fidelity wireframes. Showcased strong problem-solving skills and delivered exceptional results in crafting responsive and user-friendly internal tools. 

Quickly identified and resolved bugs and implemented new features, streamlining business processes and improving productivity.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · HTML5 · JavaScript · Figma (Software) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Front-End Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed custom marketing sites for renowned clients like Olay, Ulta Beauty, Sephora, and Emirates, showcasing proficiency in React and responsive design. 

Demonstrated strong leadership by mentoring interns in creating a React Native app demo for PureWow's recipe section.

Elevated web experiences for PureWow and ONE37PM through continuous maintenance and updates, optimizing the development process by enhancing internal React components and CSS standards, resulting in increased efficiency and scalability.

positions.title: Digital Developer
positions.description:
Led the creation of internal brand forms, propelling revenue growth by implementing innovative consumer subscriptions, gift forms, and sweepstakes. 

Played a vital role in the successful rollout of The New Yorker paywall ad, incorporating customized content for user testing and ensuring its seamless functionality on the live site.

Additionally, facilitated the efficient migration of Allure's beauty box website codebase to the internal consumer marketing platform, enhancing operational efficiency and improving user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Content Management Systems (CMS)

positions.title: Interactive Web Developer
positions.description: Specialized in crafting dynamic and user-friendly custom websites, translating clients' visions into reality through expertise in visual design and animations using CSS and JavaScript. With a proven track record of working with renowned brands such as Rolling Stone Magazine, Scholastic, American Express, and Disney. Rigorously tested and debugged code to guarantee seamless functionality, reliability, and ease of use for end-users.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · HTML5 · JavaScript · Adobe Photoshop · Node.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Web Developer / Graphic Designer
positions.description:
Led the development of Duggal Global Events' website, overseeing graphic design, wire-framing, and the final product's development. Spearheaded the re-design of company website layouts and wireframes, incorporating research for an optimal user interface. 

Additionally managed the maintenance and updates of the company's WordPress blog, social media outlets, and refreshing marketing materials to drive revenue with potential clients.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · JavaScript · Wireframing · Adobe Photoshop · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · WordPress · Sketch App

volunteerExperiences.description: I mentor fellow designers, developers, and those looking to transition careers or start their own businesses. My goal is to provide constructive and empowering feedback, helping them grow with confidence. I strive to be the mentor I wish I had when entering this field—offering guidance, support, and insight.

Proudly representing the incredible global Floxies community—a supportive network of designers and Webflow developers dedicated to learning, inspiring, and growing together. This community fosters a safe and empowering space where women can uplift and support one another. As an ambassador for the NYC/NJ sector, I am committed to expanding our presence and impact across the U.S., helping more women thrive in design and development.
